description: This file defines a PHP class 'StripeSubscriptionPaymentMethod' for handling Stripe subscription payments within the Goteo platform. It includes methods for payment gateway integration, payment processing, and subscription management.

classes.name: StripeSubscriptionPaymentMethod
classes.description: A class to manage Stripe subscription payments, including gateway interactions, payment initiation, and completion.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier for this payment method.

methods.name: getIdNonStatic
methods.description: Returns the non-static identifier for this payment method.

methods.name: getGatewayName
methods.description: Returns the name of the payment gateway.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the payment method.

methods.name: getDesc
methods.description: Returns a description of the payment method.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Returns the URL to the payment method icon.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Indicates if the payment method is active.

methods.name: isPublic
methods.description: Indicates if the payment method is public.

methods.name: getGateway
methods.description: Creates and returns the Stripe subscription gateway.

methods.name: purchase
methods.description: Initiates the purchase process via Stripe subscription.

methods.name: completePurchase
methods.description: Completes the purchase and sets the payment ID on the invest object.

methods.name: refundable
methods.description: Indicates whether the payment can be refunded.

methods.name: refund
methods.description: Processes the refund, currently throws an exception for subscriptions.

methods.name: isInternal
methods.description: Indicates if the payment method is internal.

methods.name: isSubscription
methods.description: Indicates if this is a subscription payment method.
